paper_title: Constraints on dark photon dark matter from Lyman-α forest simulations and an ultra-high signal-to-noise quasar spectrum
notes: 95% CL upper limits on the dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon from Fig. 7 (Bounds_arrows.pdf in the e-print), extracted from the vector PDF: blue downward arrows ('This work') at four fixed simulation-grid masses log10(m/eV) = -13.15, -12.9, -12.65, -12.4; the horizontal cap at the top of each arrow marks the limit (log10 eps = -13.643, -14.367, -14.375, -14.157). The paper states the mixing is not constrained within the simulated parameter grid at log m = -13.4 and log m >= -12.15, so the limit is only these four discrete points, not a continuous curve. Axis calibration verified against the Bolton+22 best-fit marker (m = 8e-14 eV, eps = 5e-15). Cosmological (IGM heating) bound assuming dark photons are all of dark matter with the cosmological abundance (Omega_m = 0.308); no local-density rescaling applied.
